1080p Full HD Camera for Video Baby Monitor BM04

Product Type
The momcozy baby monitor bm04 is a high-performance momcozy 5 inch dual mode smart baby monitor with 2 camera system. Featuring a premium 1080P camera , it serves as an advanced video baby monitor that bridges the gap between private local viewing and convenient remote monitoring.
Core Selling Points
As a top-tier momcozy dual baby monitor , it allows you to choose between a secure 2.4GHz local connection via the parent unit or a WiFi baby monitor feed via the app when you are on the go. This baby monitor with camera features intelligent AI motion detection that alerts you to risks like a covered face or face-down sleeping, alongside Danger Zone alerts. It supports continuous or motion-activated auto-recording to capture memories, which can be shared with up to 20 family members.

—— 来源（美国站）：https://momcozy.com/products/camera-for-video-baby-monitor-bm
